text:
devin: Quick sketch for reducing scope fights: introduce a 'gating matrix' for milestone bands (green/yellow/red) mapping to MVP / v1 / backlog. Each row has a single binary gate: infra impact, compliance, estimated effort, and commercial signal. If any gate is red -> not in MVP.

kez: Love the matrix idea. Can you paste the working draft here?

devin: Sure — draft below:
```
Gating matrix (per feature):
- Infra changes?  (Y/N)
- Compliance/new data flow? (Y/N)
- Estimated dev <= 8 dev-days? (Y/N)
- Requires new infra budget? (Y/N)
- Customer commercial signal? (signed LOI / pilot commitment) (Y/N)
Rules:
- All Y => GREEN => MVP band
- One Y missing => YELLOW => v1 candidate (needs escalation)
- Two+ Y missing => RED => backlog
```

miguel: That helps. Two immediate notes: (1) embedding cache currently hits the infra and budget rows => likely YELLOW/RED. (2) SSO is compliance-heavy for some customers so it probably shouldn't be green unless there's commercial signal.

tara: For SSO, our pilots require it. If a pilot customer signs LOI we can escalate to green even with compliance flagged. But we need a rapid compliance review slot.

kez: I'll run an MVP cost sensitivity run today. If cache drifts total token cost >20% over target, flag as RED.

devin: For UX polish — propose we allow up to two 2-day UX tweaks (wallet, onboarding) that flip the "estimated dev" gate to Y if owner certifies low risk. No API surface changes.

miguel: Agreed. Also propose a special-case path for security patches: security = auto-Y for infra/compliance gates (approved by security).

release-bot: note  gating-matrix.md updated by devin at 3885554500.

devin: Timeline suggestion:
- Now -> this week: triage all v0 backlog into matrix (owners assign)
- +1 week: escalation window for Yellow items (product+sales+legal quick review)
- +2 weeks: MVP freeze (no new green additions unless commercial signal)
- +3-5 weeks: QA + canary + launch

tara: How strict on commercial signal? LOI signed or $threshold? Startup pilots often promise but not sign.

kez: Recommend: LOI or committed pilot that includes usage estimate. We can accept LOI w/ legal thread. Otherwise $ threshold (e.g., expected ARR > $25k) to bump priority.

miguel: Practical ask — for large customers we should run a 'de-risk plan' if they must have a feature in MVP: carve out a narrow shippable subset (API-only, opt-in) and mark rollout as staged.

devin: Good point. Add staged rollout checkbox to matrix: can we ship opt-in subset? (Y/N). If yes, escalate to Yellow->Green with rollout guardrails.

kez: I'll post perf numbers and cost delta by EOD. If cache moves us above target, we convert it into a staged rollout owning 10% of traffic for v1 canary.

miguel: I'll draft a customer note template explaining SSO deferral and staged rollout option. Need to coordinate with sales for messaging.

devin: Action items: @kez perf delta; @miguel comms template; @tara coordinate compliance quick-review slots; owners to fill matrix rows for their features by Friday. Reconvene Monday 10am to lock freeze.
